source_scope.description: Production Node/Rudder-owned runtime sources plus database migration inputs; UI, tests, docs, native Rust, and unreferenced generated build outputs are excluded.
source_scope.rules: Resident source trees under server, identity, cli, desktop, or packages/*/src are inventoried, except packages/shared contracts. Other executable JS/TS is inventoried as unknown unless it is under an explicit UI, documentation, test, build, or tooling root. Files in test/generated/build-output-looking paths that are imported by a production source are pulled into the manifest. Database SQL files, Drizzle journals, and snapshots are separately inventoried.
source_scope.semantic_limit: Hashes and lexical structural candidates expose source and recognizable entrypoint changes; they do not prove business semantics or complete authority ownership. Every modified Node runtime source needs a reviewer-bound Rust ownership, compatibility-boundary, and retirement record. The Git review remains responsible for semantic authority review.
